request: Expand another group of NPCs, including Dale’s Simon.

scope.limits: Search discovery includes overlapping versions, false name matches and an unselected candidate. It is not exhaustive reading. Selected full quest exchanges, narrator endings and compatible public RP are read; controller data, raw text, intimate content and protected sources stay external.

introductionEdits.before: Introduces himself as willing to help; in a later scene he asks to be taken to jail for protection. The outcome is not established here.
introductionEdits.after: Simon is a young Pristinian who wants to be an adventurer and remains an eager collector of their autographs. He also cares for his grandmother, loves Cynthia and later admits joining Death’s cult in the hope of seeing her again. Reckless enthusiasm, real grief and the harm he helps cause all belong to his history.

They tend injured neighbors, organize a medicine delivery, gather useful materials and get excited about what an old alchemical legend might make possible. Stella is the elder and Sola the younger; their scenes move between professional limits, shared laughter and urgent care.

decisions: Simon, Stella and Sola, Derek and Cera remain four existing NPC identities, with original routes and media. Main quest reply traces support Dale’s authorship of selected scenes, without assigning every historical scene to the same controller.

Quest outcomes govern compatible RP. Simon’s autograph collecting, bad hunting decisions, real help and caregiving precede Cynthia and his grandmother’s death. The observed ghost fades with clouds over the moon; his later accusation against the adventurers remains his account, not a replacement for that quest ending.

The interrupted mine rite, revealed Simon and actual confession are retained with the closing narrator’s confirmed miner recovery and aboleth release. Simon’s explanation of intended mechanism and expected recovery remains attributed. His requested jail/protection is not a completed custody or judgment.

The sisters’ family notes, apology, gathering, disagreement over a tree, ward care and explicit limits remain distinct. Misha and Polya are father and daughter; no marriage is invented. The delivery quest explicitly confirms timely arrival and administration, without establishing the patient’s diagnosis or complete recovery.

Lunar Tear legend, book research, possible remedy and proposed cultivation are not a completed panacea or demonstrated universal cure. Ward, shelter and later rope work supplement rather than replace earlier scenes. No new item rules or ingredient revelations are needed.

Derek’s sarcasm, family worry, supplied brush and consent limits lead into the resumed quest’s conclusion: Rue is the fallen tree creature and the narrator establishes that Derek is told. Notification is off screen, so no exact reaction is invented. The later gremlin warning is retained, and Derek Belmont remains a separate new-arrival adventurer.

Cera’s actual burial party, grandmother-taught manners, admitted ignorance of Rahu ritual, shelter during danger and completed mass burial remain. The seven-day protection is specific to this ceremony, not a permanent safeguard or universal priestly power.

Three NPCs gain documented Prima encounter/residence associations and named navigation; four directory summaries and two generic role labels change. These are not birthplace assertions. Lilian gains only a direct Simon link. Ten older sections and their evidence survive; original narrative text is exact. Earlier census/prominence values move from opening facts into the existing archive sections, with every value retained and no new ranking.

Explicit owner confirmation makes Caravash a player character. Only their role metadata, directory membership, both discovery registries and Prima NPC association change; the complete body, sections, sources, artwork and original route remain exact.

Unrelated records, all old timeline dates/importance/adjustments, maps, quotes, relationships, media/261 previews and the complete private payload are exact. No new NPC record, portrait, runtime/style/dependency or pipeline stage is added.
